preamble: Editorial still-life photography on a seamless warm off-white cyclorama. Large soft overhead source, huge white bounce, near-shadowless with one soft contact shadow. High key, gentle contrast, warm white and pale neutral grade. Medium-format sharpness, fine grain. Photographic realism, no CGI, no text, no logos, no watermark.

images.scene: Editorial still life of a modern dental treatment chair in pale mint-white upholstery with its overhead examination lamp folded above it, standing on the seamless warm off-white cyclorama, seen from the front and slightly from the left at eye level. The chair occupies the right third of the frame; the left two thirds are empty pale cyclorama for text. Lamp switched off, no monitor, no instruments, no people, no text, no signs, no logos.

Same dental chair, same pale mint-white upholstery and same soft light as the reference, vertical frame for a phone screen. The chair stands low in the frame, in the lower half; the upper half is empty pale cyclorama for text. Lamp switched off, no monitor, no people, no text, no logos.

Close still life of two hands in pale mint nitrile gloves holding a dental mouth mirror and a slim explorer probe above a white paper-covered instrument tray, hands entering from the lower right, forearms in white sleeves, on the warm off-white cyclorama. Hands and instruments occupy the lower two thirds of the frame; empty pale space across the top for text. No face, no body, no syringe, no text, no logos.

Top-down still life of a dental treatment tray on the warm off-white cyclorama: two sealed sterilisation pouches with a mouth mirror and tweezers visible through clear film, a disposable saliva ejector, a few cotton rolls, a small paper cup, a folded white napkin and a pair of clear protective glasses. Objects arranged loosely in the lower right two thirds; large empty pale space across the upper left for text. No hands, no syringe, no text, no labels, no logos.

Dentist seen from behind, from the shoulders down, wearing pale mint scrubs, arranging instruments on a white tray beside an empty dental chair, on the warm off-white cyclorama. Head out of frame, no face at all. Figure in the lower two thirds of the frame; empty pale space above for text. No text, no logos, no jewelry, no second person.

Still life of a compact white tabletop steam autoclave with its round door open and a neat stack of sealed sterilisation pouches beside it, on the warm off-white cyclorama, seen from the front and slightly above. Display switched off and blank. Objects in the right half of the frame; empty pale space on the left for text. No hands, no text on the device, no labels, no logos.
